notes: Buffer is the source of truth for scheduled, draft-waiting-slot, and posted items. plan.json and plan-07-09.json dates (Nov 14–22) are outdated after the 11 Nov 09:08–09:10 PKT reschedule; live times are Nov 11–15.

Pulled live from Buffer (read-only) for org 6ae3a47e26d3d08c3b7e2a2c. The org has exactly three connected channels: Facebook 6ae3a5032f1f5ed64813f63b (Smart solutions.), Instagram 6ae8934fe29c69a171385101 (smartsolutions.01), TikTok 6af1808e62b70b94b0ccc743 (smartsolutions.01). No YouTube or other channels.

Buffer allows a maximum of 10 scheduled posts per channel. At this pull, FB/IG/TikTok are each 10/10 scheduled. 7 drafts have customScheduled dueAt values and wait for a free slot (status draft-waiting-slot). Today's posts free enough slots; the daily 'Buffer waiting-posts top-up' around 21:00 PKT is meant to convert those 7 at their own dueAt.
Today's Facebook Instagram kapra reel already went out at 08:01 PKT (post 6af08e08d6bbae6fa1f50cef) and is listed under posted, not scheduled.

Posted covers Buffer sent posts with dueAt/sentAt on or after 2026-10-28 00:00 PKT (last 14 days). This pull returned 26 sent posts and hasNextPage=false, so the list is complete for that window. The earliest sent post in the window is 2 Nov, not 28 Oct.

Metrics are real values returned by Buffer with includeMetrics=true. Zeros are included when Buffer returned them. Missing metric keys were not invented. Buffer notes that metrics can lag the network by up to about 24 hours; see metricsUpdatedAt_pkt on each posted item.

Local MP4 paths are best-effort matches from Drive file IDs in plan.json, plan-07-09.json, unique-reels.json and the on-disk library. A path is only set if that file exists. Some Drive IDs (especially older uploads) may point to a later re-export of the same reel.

Nov 16–20 are reserved for the 5 Meta ads reels (R1 LEARN → R5 FRESH), one calendar day, on FB+IG+TikTok. Exact clock times are not booked in Buffer yet. Voice packs m1–m5 are done; Ahmer is building the HTML. Auto-DM resources (LEARN/ORDER/IDEAS/CPA/FRESH) are still unbuilt and should go live on each reel's post day.

The 4 case-study reels (housing society AD, transport SOFTWARE, Smart POS AI, Smart POS POS) are status=script. Voice is planned today after 13:00 PKT when the Gemini TTS free-tier quota resets. No post day is reserved yet. No standalone script files for these four were found on the box; transport/POS research is in case-studies/SOFTWARE-BREAKDOWN.md. Open questions: POS live URL, and whether Z.S Enterprises can be named.

Old scripts archived on 9 Nov 2026 (archive-old-scripts-nov9) are excluded. Older voiced packs (SWI Chinese/forex, E-series, leftover E2 female, ZS transport general/soybean packs, series-nov9 automation packs, dm-course-series) are not in the current posting plan and are not listed in pipeline.

TikTok A/B hashtag test runs 10–24 Nov 2026 (max 5 tags). Version B adds #creatorsearchinsights and #tobesuccessfulatanything. Decision after 24 Nov: B wins only if its median views are more than 30% higher and it gets more Hashtag or Search traffic. See HASHTAG-RULE.md and ab-log.csv.
All times in this export are Asia/Karachi (PKT, UTC+5).

After a TikTok post is sent, Buffer often stores a Buffer S3 copy instead of the original Drive URL. For the 6 sent TikTok posts in this window, Drive file IDs and local MP4 paths were backfilled from verified-tiktok-schedule.json / unique-reels.json using the Buffer post ID. See media.drive_id_source on those items.

Posted includes one Instagram Story with no caption, sent 10 Nov 2026 at 14:54 PKT (post 6af30453b401dffbbe6ba276): 3 views, reach 0. It is not one of the scheduled feed reels. Instagram kaafi nahi (IG, sent 10 Nov 19:04 PKT, post 6af08dfb51492b796e442d3d) had no metric values from Buffer at pull time.

Many Facebook sent posts returned reach 0 and no views field. Those zeros and omissions are what Buffer returned, not estimates. Instagram feed reels generally have views, reach and averageTimeWatched.
